programme.title: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: American illusionist David Blaine gained international fame thanks to his unique combination of magic tricks and stunts.During his shows, he often took huge risks, for example allowing himself to be buried alive for seven days or spending several dozen hours in a huge block of ice.In the latest documentary series, the daredevil continues his adventure.I am looking for extraordinary people who redefine the boundaries of what is real.He visits six distant corners of the globe.Impossible?Yet!Swallowing swords, resistance to the venom of deadly reptiles and extreme frost, or athletic feats that break the laws of physics - these are just some of the challenges that are the main theme of individual episodes of the series.Blaine's escapades include: Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic Circle, Africa and Japan.The traveler introduces viewers to different traditions and rituals.Before their eyes, he tries to master unique skills.In the finale of each episode, he tries to use the acquired knowledge in practice and do something seemingly impossible.In Brazil, he meets artists, explorers and athletes.They will join forces to help him achieve a feat he has been thinking about for a long time.

programme.title: The Story of God With Morgan Freeman
programme.sub-title: Evidence for the existence of God
programme.desc: The creators of the series are looking for common elements of various world religions.Host Morgan Freeman discusses with representatives of different cultures to find universal values ​​and answers to important questions.Viewers will find out, among other things, whether God's existence can be proven and why people need prophets.They will also learn how followers of particular religions understand heaven and hell.The famous actor's interlocutors will include:A 9-year-old from Minnesota believed to be the reincarnation of a Tibetan Lama, a woman claiming to speak languages ​​from the Creator and a man who miraculously survived the September 11, 2001 attacks.Each episode is devoted to one important issue.
